title: New Austin Sewer Line Contract Awarded
summary:
*   **Federal Funding Secured:** Austin moved forward with a new 36-inch main wastewater pipeline project, utilizing federal Public Works Administration (PWA) funding.
*   **Machine Labor Mandated:** To control costs, the state engineer required the project to be completed with machine labor, saving approximately $17,000 compared to manual construction.
*   **Major Contract Approved:** The city awarded a $48,762.16 contract to Froemming Bros., Inc. of Dallas for the installation of the critical precast reinforced concrete sewer line.
